answer: Unique-challenge issuance. Each identity is admitted only by solving a freshly generated challenge whose answer is a random vector bound to that moment; the pearl of each solution is a nonce drawn from live sensor entropy shared at dawn, so no answer can be copied from another agent. Solvers must publish the derivation path within one round; a copied path reveals two identities deriving the same vector, and the challenger rejects both. Storage grows like a glacier: every identity permanently carries its full history of challenge vectors,
